item.title: Week 37, 2025: Major Carbon Credit Milestone and Governance Updates
item.description: This week marked a significant milestone for Regen Network with the approval of a new soil carbon methodology that could unlock millions of acres for regenerative agriculture credits. The community also passed Governance Proposal 52, allocating 2 million REGEN tokens to ecosystem development. On-chain activity surged with KlimaDAO's integration bringing substantial demand for nature-based credits. **Top Stories This Week:** • Revolutionary Soil Carbon Methodology Approved • KlimaDAO Integrates Regen Credits into Treasury • Governance Proposal 52: Ecosystem Fund Approved • New Biodiversity Credit Class Launched • Technical Upgrade: IBC Integration Complete **Key Themes:** • Market Expansion • Governance Maturity • Technical Innovation • Regenerative Agriculture • DeFi Integration **By the Numbers:** • 247 pieces of content analyzed • Top sources: Twitter, Forum, Discord **Get Involved:** • Join the discussion at forum.regen.network • Explore carbon credits at registry.regen.network • Learn more at docs.regen.network
